title: Two wizards: quitting from the in-world menu removes and restores the wizard
notes: After the included two-wizard and link-dead reattach checks, the companion opens the in-world menu and
chooses Quit. The game server must save and remove it from the main wizard's view; the companion then plays
again and must return at the exact position saved by the menu logout. This client build retries its spent
zone ticket after logout, so the driver ends that process after save/removal and starts a fresh client.

steps.name: the companion opens its in-world menu
the companion sees the in-world menu
the companion chooses Quit from the menu
the menu logout saves the companion's position
the main wizard sees the companion leave
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} was taken away from the (\d+) wizard\(s\) still in instance

steps.name: stop the companion after its menu logout
restart the companion after its menu logout
the companion renderer starts again after menu logout
the companion login screen appears after menu logout
log in again after menu logout
the companion account is accepted after menu logout
the companion is admitted after menu logout
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the companion character selection scene loads after menu logout
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the companion reaches character selection after menu logout
the main wizard sees the menu-quit companion removed
the companion plays again after menu logout

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the menu-quit companion returns to its saved position
the client loads the companion after menu logout
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {companion_wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the main wizard sees the companion return after menu logout
